jobs.title: Sr. Portfolio Program Manager - R&D
jobs.description:
Our Mission:

6sense's mission is to multiply what matters: growth, retention, and efficiency.  We envision a future where companies, teams and people reach their full potential.

Our People:

People are the heart and soul of 6sense. We serve with passion and purpose. We live by our Being 6sense values of Win as One Team, Stay Curious, Do The Right Thing, Own the Outcome, and Create Belonging.  Every 6sensor plays a part in deﬁning the future of our industry-leading technology.  6sense is a place where difference-makers roll up their sleeves, take risks, act with integrity, and measure success by the value we create for our customers.  We want 6sense to be the best chapter of your career.

About the Role :

We are seeking a Senior Portfolio Program Manager to provide standing, exception-based orchestration across an assigned Research & Development (R&D) pillar. Reporting to the Head of Program Management, this individual contributor partners with Product and Engineering Pillar Leaders to maintain a connected view of portfolio commitments, dependencies, risks, capacity, readiness, and key decisions while improving delivery predictability and organizational effectiveness. Combining Agile coaching with portfolio program management, the role helps teams strengthen planning discipline, execution health, and continuous improvement while translating team-level insights into actionable portfolio visibility and leadership decision support.

The role also serves as a champion for AI-enabled Program Management, continuously identifying and introducing automation, emerging technologies, and workflow improvements that increase scalability, operational efficiency, and decision-making effectiveness. The Portfolio Program Manager coordinates, synthesizes, and escalates material exceptions across teams, product areas, pillars, and functions.

Accountability for product strategy, roadmap priorities, customer outcomes, engineering architecture, technical design, staffing, performance management, team execution, Scrum practices, backlog management, Jira hygiene, funding decisions, launch approvals, and risk acceptance remains with the appropriate Product, Engineering   leaders. End-to-end ownership of strategic initiatives is assumed only when explicitly assigned.

Key Responsibilities :

- Partner with Product and Engineering Pillar Leaders to establish and maintain portfolio baselines, including commitments, milestones, dependencies, ownership, readiness expectations, capacity assumptions, and success measures.

- Maintain visibility into portfolio commitments and execution progress, surfacing material variances and coordinating appropriate change-management actions when scope, timeline, resource, or delivery commitments materially change.

- Establish and continuously improve portfolio metrics, dashboards, reporting practices, automation, and AI-enabled workflows that strengthen portfolio visibility, decision-making, execution transparency, and operational efficiency.

- Identify, evaluate, and introduce AI, automation, and emerging technologies that improve Program Management effectiveness, scalability, decision-making, and operational efficiency across the R&D pillar.

- Partner with R&D Operating System teams to improve data quality, portfolio tooling, process standards, reporting, and adoption of portfolio management practices.

- Establish and maintain visibility into cross-team and cross-pillar dependencies, ensuring ownership, impacts, required dates, and status are understood and tracked.

- Coordinate dependency management across teams and pillars, facilitate alignment, resolution discussions, and escalate unresolved risks, impacts, and decisions through established governance forums.

- Lead portfolio reviews focused on material changes, risks, dependencies, readiness gaps, capacity conflicts, and decisions requiring leadership attention.

- Facilitate scaled planning, portfolio governance, and synchronization forums that improve alignment, transparency, and execution across the pillar.

- Support quarterly planning cycles by validating commitments, dependencies, capacity assumptions, risks, and decision readiness across the pillar.

- Synthesize portfolio information into decision-ready executive insights, including risks, dependencies, trade-offs, and recommendations, and ensure resulting decisions, escalations, and accountable follow-through are tracked through closure.

- Coach Product and Engineering teams on Agile practices, planning discipline, delivery predictability, flow efficiency, and continuous improvement to strengthen execution effectiveness and delivery outcomes.

- Identify work that may warrant dedicated Strategic Initiative Program Management support and provide evidence to support coverage decisions.

- Coordinate with Strategic Initiative Program Managers to incorporate initiative health, dependencies, change impacts, and readiness into the pillar portfolio view.

Qualifications :

- 8+ years of experience in Portfolio Management, Program Management, Technical Program Management, Product Operations, or related roles within a SaaS or technology environment.

- Experience leading Product and Engineering portfolios spanning multiple teams, product areas, or organizational units.

- Experience establishing and leading portfolio governance frameworks, operating rhythms, quarterly planning processes, executive review forums, and reporting mechanisms that improve visibility, alignment, decision-making, and execution predictability.

- Demonstrated success managing portfolio risk, dependencies, capacity constraints, competing priorities, and roadmap execution at scale.

- Experience facilitating executive, leadership, and cross-functional governance forums that drive alignment, accountability, and decision-making.

- Demonstrated success improving team effectiveness, delivery predictability, planning maturity, flow efficiency, and execution outcomes through Agile coaching, facilitation, and continuous improvement practices.

- Demonstrated ability to influence without formal authority, navigate ambiguity, clarify accountability, and drive alignment, decision-making, and follow-through across multiple stakeholders.

- Experience identifying, evaluating, and implementing automation, AI-enabled workflows, and emerging technologies that improve portfolio visibility, operational efficiency, scalability, and decision-making effectiveness.

- Strong analytical, facilitation, communication, and stakeholder-management skills, with the ability to synthesize complex information into executive-ready insights and recommendations.

- Working knowledge of Productboard, Jira, Confluence, dashboarding, and business intelligence platforms.

- Agile coaching or Agile delivery certifications such as ICP-ACC, CSP, CSM, PSM, SAFe SPC, SAFe Agilist, or equivalent practical experience.

- Bachelor's degree or equivalent practical experience.

Success In This Role :

- Trusted portfolio visibility enables informed leadership decisions.

- Risks, dependencies, and changes to commitments  are identified and addressed early.

- Capacity and readiness issues are surfaced before they impact delivery.

- Portfolio governance drives timely decisions and clear accountability.

- Strategic initiatives are integrated into a unified portfolio view.

- Teams improve commitment reliability, delivery predictability, and flow efficiency over time.

- Stakeholders experience greater alignment and faster decision-making with minimal reporting overhead.

- Automation and AI improve operational efficiency, scalability, and insight quality.

Our Benefits:

Full-time employees can take advantage of health coverage, paid parental leave, generous paid time-off and holidays, quarterly self-care days off, and stock options. We’ll make sure you have the equipment and support you need to work and connect with your teams, at home or in one of our oﬃces.

We have a growth mindset culture that is represented in all that we do, from onboarding through to numerous learning and development initiatives including access to our LinkedIn Learning platform. Employee well-being is also top of mind for us. We host quarterly wellness education sessions to encourage self care and personal growth. From wellness days to ERG-hosted events, we celebrate and energize all 6sense employees and their backgrounds.

Qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to race, color, religion, sex, sexual orientation, gender perception or identity, national origin, age, marital status, protected veteran status, or disability status. The Job:

Reporting to the CFO, you will work closely with 6sense’s executive team, business partners, department heads, and key stakeholders to develop and implement short- and long-term financial models and strategies that align with the company's strategic and financial objectives. You will provide valuable analytical insights and decision-making support to facilitate the achievement of our financial targets and drive overall business performance. To be successful in his role, you’ll need a broad strategic mindset, innate curiosity, executive presence, and strong financial planning process and systems experience.  Our mission is to maximize the company’s long-term valuation by enabling the leadership team to plan, prioritize, and execute effectively.

Our objectives

- Align and facilitate cross-functional execution of 6sense’s strategy

- Bring predictability and operational rigor

- Ensure financial and operational goals of 6sense are defined, documented and achieved

- Evangelize awareness of strategy and each department's role in achieving it

- Ensure sound, data-driven decision support

- Ensure our company narrative aligns with operating strategy

You will :

Own Financial Analysis and Reporting and Operational Efficiency:

- Own the Operating model end to end incorporating capacity, topline, expenses, financial statement, cash forecasting.

- Timely reporting to the Exec team and Board. Drive the 409a, Investor relationship and reporting in the format requested/ on the investor platform.

- Lead the monthly forecasting process, manage collaboration with various business units, oversee preparation of materials for management reviews, and highlight key trends, risks and opportunities.

- Be responsible for the quarter-end flash forecasting process in partnership with accounting team to review financial forecasts against quarter end expectations, provide insightful analysis and prepare management review materials to drive decisions.

- Prepare all quarterly financial information and analysis to consolidate financial analysis & reporting, provide detailed business performance insights, and manage internal and board reporting.

- Own the rolling forecast process and provide actionable insights to ensure departmental performance versus plan. Develop reporting calendar leading to predictable and timely reporting to the business.

- Drive accountability through the annual budgeting process.  Constantly look for opportunities to improve performance analytics, cost efficiencies, process improvements and education.

Provide Cross-functional Support:

- Support the Go-to-Market organization in capacity and productivity planning, comp scenarios, span of control analysis.

- Provide support to the People team on compensation, hiring plan, benefits, and equity planning.

- Assist cross functional teams in financial aspects relating to the company OKR process and ad hoc strategic analysis.

- Assist R&D org with the multi-product ROI analysis, Product ARR, resource allocation and cloud cost optimization.

- Assist with ad hoc analysis related to new business ventures, renewal of existing relationships, and potential M&A.

Strategic Financial Planning:

- Own the development of long-term financial models in alignment with the company's strategic objectives and define business drivers and KPIs.

- Prepare financial forecasts and budgets, a ct as business thought leader  and provide insights into market perceptions and industry trends, and competitive landscape that may impact the company's valuation and reputation.

- Oversee preparing financial plans for various scenarios, including cash position and potential risks.

- Advise senior leaders on financial matters offering data-driven recommendations for operational efficiency and desired business outcomes.

Implement and Elevate Systems and Processes:

- Improve upon various FP&A processes by streamlining existing processes and leveraging automation where possible.

- Overall responsibility for financial planning tool, automation of dashboards via centralized Enterprise Data Warehouse (Snowflake) and using AI tools

- Drive timeliness and accuracy within the organization’s financial planning processes.

- Collaborate on financial data analytics and work closely with the business technology team to develop dashboards.

- Develop and execute strategies to optimize the company's valuation and preserve the liqudity.

Provide Team Leadership and Development:

- Lead and mentor the FP&A team, fostering a culture of high performance and continuous improvement.

- Ensure team members have the necessary skills and tools to effectively contribute to the company's financial objectives.

You have:

- A bachelor’s degree in finance, accounting, economics, or a related field; an MBA or CFA or CPA preferred

- A minimum of 10-15 years of relevant experience in financial planning and analysis, with a significant portion in a leadership role

- Prior experience in SaaS at scale, experience with Private Equity is a must have.

- Demonstrated success in consistently producing timely and highly predictable financial models

- Experience project managing and implementing financial reporting systems

- Innate curiosity to understand overall business and industry trends, and use these insights to devise ad hoc analysis to surface business risks and opportunities

- Excellent verbal and written communication skills, with the ability to convey complex financial concepts in a simplified way to leaders

- Ability to work under pressure and manage deadlines

- Proactive, self-motivated, and able to work in a dynamic and fast-paced environment

jobs.title: Manager, Customer Success - Upmarket
jobs.description:
Our Mission:

6sense's mission is to multiply what matters: growth, retention, and efficiency.  We envision a future where companies, teams and people reach their full potential.

Our People:

People are the heart and soul of 6sense. We serve with passion and purpose. We live by our Being 6sense values of Win as One Team, Stay Curious, Do The Right Thing, Own the Outcome, and Create Belonging.  Every 6sensor plays a part in deﬁning the future of our industry-leading technology.  6sense is a place where difference-makers roll up their sleeves, take risks, act with integrity, and measure success by the value we create for our customers.  We want 6sense to be the best chapter of your career.

The Role

As a Manager, Customer Success, you will lead a team of approximately 7-8 Customer Success Managers responsible for a combined portfolio of Upmarket customers with annual contract values ranging from $100K to $500K and representing approximately $15M-$20M in ARR.

You will be responsible for driving customer retention, adoption, customer value realization, and operational excellence across your team's portfolio while developing and coaching a high-performing team of Customer Success Managers. This role requires a strong people leader who can balance business performance, talent development, forecasting discipline, and customer outcomes.

Success in this role requires the ability to develop top talent, create accountability, establish operational rigor, and partner cross-functionally to ensure customers realize measurable business value from their investment in 6sense.

You will work closely with Sales, Professional Services, Support, Product, Marketing, and Revenue Operations to help customers achieve their goals while contributing to the continued growth and scale of the Customer Success organization.

What You'll Do

Lead and Develop a High-Performing Team

- Lead, coach, and develop a team of approximately 7-8 Customer Success Managers supporting Upmarket customers.

- Create a culture of accountability, customer-centricity, collaboration, and continuous improvement.

- Conduct regular coaching sessions, performance reviews, talent assessments, and career development conversations.

- Establish clear expectations and operating rhythms that drive consistent execution and customer outcomes.

- Recruit, onboard, and develop Customer Success talent while supporting succession planning across the organization.

- Inspire and motivate a team that consistently delivers exceptional customer experiences and business results.

Drive Customer Success Outcomes

- Lead a team responsible for customers with annual contract values between $100K and $500K and a combined portfolio of approximately $15M-$20M in ARR.

- Drive strong Gross Revenue Retention (GRR), customer adoption, customer satisfaction, and value realization across the portfolio.

- Coach Customer Success Managers on account strategy, executive stakeholder engagement, success planning, renewal strategy, risk mitigation, and value delivery, ensuring they understand and own the renewal process.

- Ensure Customer Success Managers proactively identify customer risks and execute strategies to improve retention outcomes.

- Partner with Sales leadership to align on customer health, growth opportunities, and strategic account planning.

- Drive a high level of customer engagement and executive alignment across key accounts.

Drive Operational Excellence

- Own portfolio forecasting processes, renewal inspections, customer health reviews, and risk management practices.

- Ensure consistent execution of success plans, Executive Business Reviews (EBRs), account reviews, and customer engagement standards.

- Use data and analytics to identify trends, improve performance, and drive informed decision-making.

- Drive adoption of Customer Success processes, tools, and best practices across the team.

- Champion initiatives that improve efficiency, scalability, forecast accuracy, and customer outcomes.

Partner Across the Business

- Collaborate closely with Sales, Product, Professional Services, Support, Marketing, and RevOps to deliver a world-class customer experience.

- Act as a voice of the customer and advocate for customer needs across the organization.

- Support strategic initiatives focused on customer retention, product adoption, operational scale, and customer value realization.

- Help shape the future of Customer Success programs, processes, and operating models as the business continues to grow.

What We're Looking For

- 5+ years of people leadership experience leading customer-facing teams within a SaaS organization.

- 8+ years of experience in Customer Success, Account Management, Professional Services, Consulting, or other customer-facing roles.

- Proven track record of building, developing, and retaining high-performing teams.

- Experience leading teams responsible for customer retention, adoption, and customer outcomes.

- Strong understanding of SaaS business models and key metrics, including GRR, churn, forecasting, customer health, and product adoption.

- Experience coaching teams on executive engagement, account strategy, value realization, and risk management.

- Excellent communication, coaching, and leadership skills.

- Demonstrated ability to drive operational rigor and accountability through data-driven management practices.

- Strong analytical and problem-solving skills with the ability to translate data into action.

- Comfortable leveraging AI-powered tools and workflows to improve team productivity, customer insights, coaching effectiveness, and operational scale.

- Ability to thrive in a fast-paced, high-growth environment.

- Ability to travel up to 25% for customer meetings, team events, and company programs.

Preferred Qualifications

- Experience leading Customer Success teams supporting enterprise or upmarket SaaS customers.

- Experience managing teams responsible for portfolios between $15M and $20M in ARR.

- Experience within MarTech, AdTech, SalesTech, Revenue Technology, or related B2B SaaS industries.

- Familiarity with Salesforce, Gainsight, Clari, Gong, and other customer success technologies.

- Experience helping scale Customer Success organizations, teams, and operating models.

Why 6sense

At 6sense, you'll have the opportunity to lead a talented team, influence the future of Customer Success, and directly impact customer retention and business outcomes across a diverse portfolio of Upmarket customers.

You'll work alongside some of the industry's most innovative leaders while helping customers transform how they identify, engage, and convert buyers. You'll have the autonomy to make an impact, the support of a world-class leadership team, and the opportunity to grow your career while developing the next generation of Customer Success talent.

If you're passionate about building great teams, creating exceptional customer outcomes, and helping scale a world-class Customer Success organization, we'd love to hear from you.

jobs.title: Senior Digital Program Manager
jobs.description:
Our Mission:

6sense's mission is to multiply what matters: growth, retention, and efficiency.  We envision a future where companies, teams and people reach their full potential.

Our People:

People are the heart and soul of 6sense. We serve with passion and purpose. We live by our Being 6sense values of Win as One Team, Stay Curious, Do The Right Thing, Own the Outcome, and Create Belonging.  Every 6sensor plays a part in deﬁning the future of our industry-leading technology.  6sense is a place where difference-makers roll up their sleeves, take risks, act with integrity, and measure success by the value we create for our customers.  We want 6sense to be the best chapter of your career.

About the Role

6sense is hiring a Senior Digital Program Manager to build and run the digital engagement engine for our Customer Success organization. This is a hybrid role: an expert-level Gainsight builder, program lead, and strategist. You will own the platform and, more importantly, You will own the platform and the quality of what gets built on it: the journeys, programs, and measurement that put CS strategy into action at scale. You are accountable for how they are built, for their accuracy, and for reporting on how they perform. Your primary focus will be to build and operate the digital programs that carry out CS strategy, report on where they are working and where customers are going unengaged, and recommend what to build next within CS priorities.

You will partner closely with CS Leadership, CS Operations, Marketing, Product, and Support. You are not a ticket-taker: you identify the gaps, propose the program, build it, launch it, and prove its impact.

What This Role Is – And Isn't

This role is for someone who has done this before and does not need a runway. We need a builder and program owner, not a resource waiting to be directed.

- You move fast and ship. Journeys launch in weeks, not months. We do not wait for perfect requirements; we iterate.

- You lead, not just execute. You do not wait for requests. You use data to find where customers are not being engaged, then bring a proposed program, a business case, and a plan.

- You flag blockers immediately. Unclear or missing requirements are raised the same day, with a recommendation attached.

- You own your backlog. You prioritize your own backlog and drive to resolution. We review outputs; we do not track status.

- You know the difference between "I need input" and "I need permission." Judgment calls within scope get made. Questions that need business context get escalated quickly.

Key Responsibilities

Digital Program Strategy & Ownership

- Own the strategy, roadmap, and calendar for CS digital programs across the customer lifecycle: onboarding, adoption, value realization, renewal, and expansion.

- Design and launch strategic, segment-level programs and journeys, aligned to customer segmentation, health scoring, and CS coverage models.

- Build the business case for each program: audience, objective, success metrics, content needs, and required resources. Prioritize the roadmap with CS Leadership.

- Act as project and program lead for cross-functional digital initiatives, coordinating Marketing, Product, Support, Sales, and Enablement to deliver on time.

- Pilot and evaluate new engagement channels and tactics (in-app, email, community, webinars, and others) and scale what works.

Digital Journey & Campaign Build

- Design and build automated journeys in Gainsight, including conditional logic, multi-step triggers, and data-driven audiences.

- Create, manage, and optimize email programs and in-app campaigns targeting customers at key lifecycle moments. Partner with Marketing and CS on messaging, and own campaign hygiene and governance.

- Build and maintain audience segments, rules, and triggers for digital touchpoints; connect digital programs to CTAs and human-led plays so digital and CSM engagement work together.

- A/B test content, timing, and cadence; report results and iterate.

Engagement Coverage & Gap Analysis

- Track engagement: which customers, segments, and lifecycle stages are receiving touches, and which are not.

- Identify and quantify gaps – unengaged accounts, stalled onboarding, low adoption, at-risk renewals with no digital or human outreach – and turn them into prioritized programs and recommendations.

- Maintain a clear view of program progress against plan, and present findings and next steps to CS Leadership on a regular cadence.

Gainsight Platform Leader

- Serve as the primary Gainsight Lead for Customer Success, owning building, data integrity, and platform health in regards to digital customer lifecycle.

- Ensure Snowflake, Salesfoce, and other connectors data ingestion into Gainsight is usable for customer lifecycle programs

- Document configurations, processes, and runbooks proactively.

Reporting, Analytics & Insights

- Build and maintain dashboards and reports for CS Leadership

- Track journey and program performance: reach, open and click rates, engagement, stage progression, product adoption, and influence on retention and expansion.

- Provide regular, data-backed recommendations to improve program effectiveness and to inform coverage and resourcing decisions.

CS Ops & Leadership Partnership

- Translate CS Leadership priorities and CS Ops workflows into programs and Gainsight builds quickly and with minimal hand-holding.

- Participate in regular syncs with CS Ops and Leadership to gather requirements, share updates, and surface dependency gaps before they cause delays.

- Enable CSMs to act on digital program outputs, and communicate program changes clearly.

Qualifications

Required

- 4–6+ years in Customer Success Operations, Digital/Scaled Customer Success, or lifecycle programs, including 3–5 years of hands-on Gainsight Building (or admin level type access).

- Proven experience designing, building, and managing Journey Orchestrator programs and email campaigns from strategy through measurement.

- Demonstrated program or project leadership: you have owned cross-functional initiatives and delivered measurable outcomes.

- Strong understanding of the Gainsight data model – MDA, relationships, connectors, and Rules Engine.

- Experience with Snowflake-to-Gainsight data ingestion, including connector setup, MDA mapping, and pipeline troubleshooting.

- Proficiency with Salesforce integrations and how Gainsight syncs with SFDC, Snowflake, and other data providers.

- Experience using data to identify engagement gaps and turn them into prioritized programs.

- Working knowledge of customer lifecycle management, segmentation, and health scoring in a B2B SaaS environment.

- Ability to work independently, manage competing priorities, and deliver without oversight.

- Track record of fast execution: you have built dashboards in a day and launched journeys in a week.

- Strong written and verbal communication, with executive presence and the ability to document for technical and non-technical audiences.

Nice to Have

- Gainsight Admin certification.

- Experience with health scoring model design and maintenance.

- Hands-on experience with Pendo, including building in-app guides and messaging, defining behavioral segments, analyzing product usage and adoption, and using insights to trigger targeted digital CS journeys

- Experience using Claude, Microsoft Copilot, and Workato to accelerate content creation, automate workflows, and scale digital CS programs.

- Experience with lifecycle marketing, in-app messaging, or digital customer success programs at scale.

- Experience with Tableau or similar BI tools; familiarity with SQL.

- Experience in a commercial or mid-market CS motion supporting a large, digitally served customer base.

What Success Looks Like

First 15 days: The Gainsight digital programs have been reviewed and the backlog is prioritized and agreed with CS Ops and CS Leadership. An initial engagement coverage baseline for the commercial book shows where customers are and are not being reached. Quick-win deliverables are shipped (dashboards, segments, reports), and at least one digital journey is live in production.

Within 30 days: Existing journeys have been updated and new programs are being launched. Full program and campaign calendar is underway. A strategic program roadmap for the Commercial book is reviewed and approved by CS Leadership. Performance and gap reporting is in place and stakeholders are reviewing results.

Within 45 days: Engagement gaps prioritized by CS Leadership have programs in market, with measurable movement in reach and engagement. A recurring cadence for program review and gap reporting is established, and digital and CSM-led motions are connected through CTAs and plays.
